one_loop: MSSM with two complete vectorlike 5 pairs above 10 PeV, their direct Higgs Yukawa inputs zero, three active charged families and original four L-conserving neutral columns. Pure II uses an active local operator up to the crossing. For mixed I+II stop the original EFT at the lightest new pole. An additional explicitly separate sequential tree matching inserts the projected holomorphic Yukawa column at each assigned physical mass using the common light transport and a block diagonal heavy matching. The type-II source remains local; no independent finite flavour terms.
sterile_threshold_normalization: vu=246.22 sin(beta) GeV with inherited tan(beta), versus 246.22 GeV for the companion R1799 control; all three estimated masses scale by sin²(beta).
